'''Kuhurrik''' was the seventh [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kashyyyk (star)/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], located in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]], portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] Territories. Kuhurrik had twenty-five [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kuhurrik was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the Kashyyyk system, and therefore Kuhurrik, in grid square P-9.<ref name="EA" />
